verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a plausible offering for a SaaS team-inbox product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents a REST API, an official MCP server, webhooks and an in-app command bar (⌘/Ctrl+K). None of these is an official command-line tool: the API and MCP server are developer building blocks or a different story, and the command bar is an adjacent in-app feature.
